product_overview: A desktop-first Bill of Quantities calculator for construction professionals in Pakistan and South Asia. The product helps users define room-based specifications, manage shared wall entities, calculate quantities and costs, and export professional BOQ reports offline.
core_goals: Create and manage construction projects with structured BOQ data
Automatically calculate material quantities using room dimensions and construction thumb-rules
Model shared walls correctly so adjacent spaces are not double-counted
Provide an efficient AG Grid-based editing experience for desktop users
Maintain a local, offline-first data store for uninterrupted use
Generate reports, payment plans, and exports for construction planning and client review

features.name: Project Management
features.description: Allows users to create and maintain construction projects that serve as the basis for BOQ calculations and reporting.
user_flows: POST /api/projects with valid project details -> Receive 201 with created project data -> GET /api/projects -> Receive 200 with project list -> GET /api/projects/:id -> Receive 200 with full project details
POST /api/projects with missing required fields -> Receive 400 with validation error response -> GET /api/projects/:id for non-existent project -> Receive 404 with not found response

features.name: Room-Based Specification Engine
features.description: Enables users to define floors and rooms with dimensions so quantities for construction materials can be calculated automatically.
user_flows: POST /api/specifications with room dimensions and floor data -> Receive 201 with calculated specification output -> GET /api/specifications/:id -> Receive 200 with saved room specification and derived quantities -> PUT /api/specifications/:id with updated dimensions -> Receive 200 with recalculated results

POST /api/specifications with invalid dimensions or malformed payload -> Receive 400 with validation errors -> PUT /api/specifications/:id with unsupported room data -> Receive 422 with calculation or business-rule error

features.name: Wall Entity Management
features.description: Stores each wall once and associates it with adjacent spaces using independent faces so shared walls are not double-counted.
user_flows: POST /api/walls with two linked spaces and face settings -> Receive 201 with wall entity and both face records -> GET /api/walls/:id -> Receive 200 with shared wall details and status -> PUT /api/walls/:id with updated face finish types -> Receive 200 with recalculated BOQ contribution

POST /api/walls with missing neighbor reference for a linked wall -> Receive 400 with validation error -> DELETE /api/walls/:id for a wall referenced by active spaces -> Receive 409 with conflict response

features.name: BOQ Editor
features.description: Provides a spreadsheet-style AG Grid interface for creating, editing, copying, pasting, and reordering BOQ line items.
user_flows: GET /api/boq/items -> Receive 200 with BOQ line items -> POST /api/boq/items with a new line item -> Receive 201 with created item -> PUT /api/boq/items/:id with inline edits -> Receive 200 with updated item -> DELETE /api/boq/items/:id -> Receive 204 with item removed
POST /api/boq/items with invalid quantity or rate values -> Receive 400 with validation errors -> PUT /api/boq/items/:id with unsupported section data -> Receive 422 with update rejected response

features.name: Rate Library
features.description: Maintains editable material and labour rates used throughout the calculator and report generation.
user_flows: GET /api/rates -> Receive 200 with current rate library -> POST /api/rates with a new rate card -> Receive 201 with created rate entry -> PUT /api/rates/:id with revised pricing -> Receive 200 with updated rate -> DELETE /api/rates/:id -> Receive 204 with rate removed
POST /api/rates with non-numeric rate values -> Receive 400 with validation error -> PUT /api/rates/:id with missing unit or category -> Receive 422 with business-rule validation error

features.name: Payment Plans
features.description: Creates and recalculates milestone-based construction payment schedules across eight phases.
user_flows: POST /api/payments/plans with a total project cost and milestone setup -> Receive 201 with payment schedule -> GET /api/payments/plans/:id -> Receive 200 with milestone breakdown -> PUT /api/payments/plans/:id after total cost changes -> Receive 200 with recalculated milestone amounts

POST /api/payments/plans with negative totals or incomplete milestones -> Receive 400 with validation error -> PUT /api/payments/plans/:id with invalid phase distribution -> Receive 422 with schedule validation error

features.name: Reports and Summaries
features.description: Generates phase-wise BOQ breakdowns and quantity summaries for review and decision-making.
user_flows: GET /api/reports/boq-summary -> Receive 200 with BOQ summary data -> GET /api/reports/material-summary -> Receive 200 with material quantity summary -> GET /api/reports/phase-breakdown -> Receive 200 with phase-wise cost breakdown

GET /api/reports/boq-summary with invalid filters or date parameters -> Receive 400 with validation error -> GET /api/reports/material-summary with no available data -> Receive 404 with empty-report response

features.name: Export and Printing
features.description: Exports BOQ data to PDF, Excel, and print-friendly layouts for client delivery and offline sharing.
user_flows: POST /api/export/pdf with a valid project payload -> Receive 200 with generated PDF file metadata -> POST /api/export/excel -> Receive 200 with spreadsheet export metadata -> POST /api/export/print -> Receive 200 with print layout response
POST /api/export/pdf with incomplete project data -> Receive 400 with export validation error -> POST /api/export/excel with unsupported file options -> Receive 422 with export rejected response

features.name: Offline Data Persistence
features.description: Persists all project, BOQ, wall, rate, and report data locally so the app remains usable without internet connectivity.
user_flows: GET /api/storage/status -> Receive 200 with offline storage availability -> POST /api/storage/sync with local data snapshot -> Receive 200 with persistence confirmation -> GET /api/storage/status -> Receive 200 with cached data state

POST /api/storage/sync with corrupted payload -> Receive 400 with persistence validation error -> GET /api/storage/status when local store is unavailable -> Receive 503 with storage unavailable response

features.name: Authentication API
features.description: JWT-based authentication with login, token verification, and role-based access
user_interactions: Token validated by middleware on protected routes

features.name: Inventory API
features.description: Full CRUD for items, warehouses, stock movements with batch costing

features.name: Sales API
features.description: Full sales cycle with quotations, sales orders, invoices, and returns

features.name: Production API
features.description: BOM and production work order management with material consumption

known_limitations.issue: Batch costing migration is recent - edge cases may exist
known_limitations.impact: Stock valuation may be affected for existing data

known_limitations.issue: Express v5 router syntax differs from v4
known_limitations.impact: Some middleware patterns may behave differently

known_limitations.issue: better-sqlite3 is synchronous, no async/await for queries
known_limitations.impact: All DB operations block the event loop
